name: Silent Image
description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration.
effect: An illusion to hide behind. In a fight: an illusory double takes the next attack that would hit you (concentration). On the road: +3 Thieving for 2 hours.
notes: In combat: the next attack that would hit you strikes an illusory double instead. Concentration, 10 rounds.
Out of combat: +3 Thieving for 2 hours.
